overview: Research draft record, unpublished: every statement below is an unverified lead, not a verified fact. Described in search results as a multi-faculty university (state) in Lutsk (Луцьк), Volyn Oblast, Ukraine, with leads for dentistry, medicine programmes. Draft record built from search-result leads on 2026-10-24; no official page was opened (official hosts are refused by this environment's network policy). No fee, deadline or intake date is recorded. Every field is awaiting verification against the official pages listed under research references, and nothing here is presented as a current fact.

openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.
Location lead as found (unverified): Lutsk (Луцьк), Volyn Oblast

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead. Lutsk, Volyn Oblast (north-west Ukraine) is the reported base in every lead; the Department of Internal and Family Medicine lists "Lutsk, Bankova Street, 9" (wiki.vnu.edu.ua, undated). Recent activity leads: first Medical Faculty masters graduated 23 June 2025 (vnu.edu.ua/en news); tuition for 2026/2027 entrants approved (zaxid.net, headline "Подорожчання до 28%"). No occupied-territory or front-line lead.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No lead shows foreign applicants admitted to, or English-medium teaching of, Medicine or Dentistry. The university's own invitation to foreign citizens (vnu.edu.ua/uk news, undated) names teaching languages Ukrainian, English, French and German and lists strengths in economics, information systems, international relations, tourism and journalism; medicine is not mentioned. Consistent with the inventory flag 'no programme for foreigners shown'.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: The Medical Faculty is new (programme review dated 2020; first master's graduates 23 June 2025). No NAQA accreditation decision for 222 Medicine was found; accreditation status is unverified.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Dentistry (221) rests on one 2026/2027 fee snippet from zaxid.net; no licence, EDEBO or NAQA lead.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion risk: (a) a separate communal institution 'Volyn Medical Institute' (КЗВО «Волинський медичний інститут» Волинської обласної ради, Lutsk) exists in the inventory (group G) and is NOT the same body; (b) 2012-2020 name 'Lesya Ukrainka Eastern European National University' still appears in third-party and academic sources.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: International-applicant pages seen in results reference the 2020-2021 academic year (deadlines 1 November and 1 March; pre-study language courses in Ukrainian or Russian, 6-10 months) and may be outdated; no current international prospectus found.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Tuition volatility: contract fees for Medicine rose from about 29,500-40,000 UAH/year (2022-2024, vstup.osvita.ua) to 58,700 UAH/year for 2026/2027 entrants (zaxid.net); figures are domestic contract fees, not foreign-applicant fees.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: All findings are search-result leads; no official page, EDEBO record or NAQA record was read (network policy blocks those hosts).
